decisions.reason: The copper-coated glass packaging substrates extend the firm's core glass processing, polishing and patterning know-how into growing 3D-integration and high-frequency markets, and its own R&D and EU project experience let it learn from early customer results, so this flagship line should be kept.

The VLIS laser structuring for through-glass vias builds on the firm's glass expertise and complements its packaging substrates. Its own R&D and research cooperation give it the absorptive capacity to refine this new flagship technology, so it should be kept.
